cases.name: Eyvonne Bender
cases.about: She was a student at Niles West High School.
cases.narrative: Their car was found at a shopping center near Waukegan and Dempster roads. Their purses were inside, but there were no sign of the girls. Their bodies were later found that night in the St. Paul Woods Forest Preserve in Morton Grove.
